notes: 11 conditions x 3 replicates of RelA-mVenus BMDMs.
Condition codes are two letters, first stimulus then second: F=media, C=CpG, L=LPS, T=TNF, P=polyI:C (CF CL CT FC FF FL FP FT PF PL PT).
Processed per-sample files are Rsubread featureCounts objects (GSM*Aligned.RData.gz) whose counts are keyed by Entrez GeneID.
9 conditions x 2 replicates; condition codes use M for media (CL CT MC ML MM MP MT PL PT), unlike the RNA series which uses F.
This is the matrix the Tay deposit ships as a bare logCPM.csv at its root, and the one the v0 run mistook for RNA-seq.
guard_atac.note: This is the file the v0 run analysed as if it were RNA-seq. The guard classifies its row IDs as genomic intervals and its sample count as 18, both matching GSE261647 ATAC-seq and neither matching GSE260996.
